shortDescription: China has broadened its onshore central clearing system to include more foreign currencies as it pushes direct trading in yuan and seeks to reduce reliance on the dollar, according to Bloomberg.The move is another step in Beijing’s effort to promote the yuan’s global use.

title: China Expands Central Clearing to More Foreign Currencies
